_comment: Per-file allowlist only. Blanket directory entries (screens/, parts/, control-panel/, wlt/frontend/dsh/) removed 2026-06-15. Each entry covers only the rules that file actually triggers.
_allowlistMetaNote: Parallel metadata for each allowlist entry. Does not affect guard logic — guard reads only 'allowlist'. Each entry documents: owner, reason, expiry, removalStep, blocksClosure.
